mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbox_events (event_id, group_id, activity_id, aggregate_id, type, payload, generation, policy_revision, occurred_at, delivered_at, attempts) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{groupId}, #{activityId}, #{aggregateId}, #{type}, #{payload}, #{generation}, #{policyRevision}, #{occurredAt}, #{deliveredAt}, #{attempts})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM outbox_events WHERE sequence > #{cursor} ORDER BY sequence LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM outbox_events WHERE delivered_at IS NULL ORDER BY sequence LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox_events SET delivered_at = NOW() WHERE event_id = #{eventId}
UPDATE outbox_events SET attempts = attempts + 1 WHERE event_id = #{eventId}
